pattern: (signed[- ]out|unauthenticated|while signed out|without (being )?signed|not signed in|another (user|customer)|other user|different user).*(account|profile|orders?|data)|(account|orders?|profile).*(signed[- ]out|unauthenticated|without (being )?signed|while signed out|another (user|customer)|other user|leak)
note: The garden never gates /account or /orders behind sign-in, so a visitor reads and edits Ada's profile and order history. Not planted, but a real flaw of the fixture; every model that reports it earns the finding.
The Cart link has no badge by design; a missing feature is not a defect.

"Your cart is empty. Browse the catalog." is punctuated correctly; the accessibility tree separates the link text from the trailing period, so the flattened observation reads "empty. .". A harness artifact, reported by six models.
There are no detail pages in the shop; a missing feature is not a defect.
Order rows show id, total, and date by design.

pattern: (place order|checkout|form).*(does nothing|no validation|silently|no feedback|without validation|no (error|validation) message|enabled)
note: The shipping address is a native `required` input: the browser blocks the submit and shows its own tooltip, which the accessibility tree does not carry. An empty cart redirects checkout back to the cart, which says so.
The quantity floors at 1 server-side; a control that stays enabled at the floor is a design choice.
The profile form has no name validation by design.
The explorer had edited the profile email itself earlier in the run; the page showed its own change.
